title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Data Quality Analyst
London (2 days per week) | £60,000 - £80,000 + benefits


Looking for a role where you can shape how data quality is managed across a growing data function? This is an opportunity to join a well-established global organisation that is investing heavily in its data capabilities, modernising its technology stack, and building a best-in-class data environment. You'll work across the business to improve data quality, influence stakeholders, and play a key role in major transformation programmes.

The Company

This global professional services organisation is undergoing significant investment in data, analytics, and AI. With a growing data team and several large-scale transformation initiatives underway, they are focused on building strong data foundations to support better decision-making across the business.
You'll be joining a relatively new team where there is genuine opportunity to help shape processes, influence strategy, and contribute to the long-term growth of the function.

The Role

As a Data Quality Analyst, you will work closely with business stakeholders and data teams to improve the quality, consistency, and reliability of critical business data.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Partnering with teams across Finance, operations, Marketing and other business areas to identify and resolve data quality issues
  • Conducting data profiling, gap analysis, and root cause investigations to improve data reliability
  • Supporting data quality monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities
  • Creating dashboards, scorecards, and reporting to measure data health and track improvement initiatives
  • Helping stakeholders understand data changes and the impact on business processes
  • Working closely with Data Governance colleagues to support wider data management initiatives
  • Contributing to major transformation projects, including cloud and enterprise data platform migrations
  • Supporting project delivery and communicating progress and outcomes to key stakeholders

Your Skills & Experience

  • Experience in a Data Quality, Data Management, Data Governance, or related data-focused role
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working across multiple business functions
  • Commercial experience using SQL for data analysis, profiling, or investigation
  • Experience identifying, analysing, and resolving data quality issues
  • Ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, or data quality metrics
  • Exposure to SAP environments would be advantageous
  • Knowledge of Databricks would be beneficial but is not essential
  • Comfortable working in a growing function where processes and frameworks are still being developed

What They Offer

  • Salary of £60,000 - £80,000
  • Hybrid working with 2 days per week in the London office
  • Opportunity to join a growing data function during a period of significant investment
  • Exposure to large-scale transformation programmes, including Databricks adoption and enterprise system migrations
  • Clear opportunity to influence processes, frameworks, and ways of working
  • Strong career development prospects within a global organisation
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Please note that sponsorship is not available for this position.

How to Apply

If you're interested in using your data quality expertise to help shape a growing data function and contribute to high-profile transformation programmes, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to learn more
